Welcome
Rowhill School is a School for pupils with behaviour and learning needs.
Approximately two thirds of pupils are of secondary school age; All pupils have a Educational Health Care Plan (EHCP) that is primarily for their behavioural, social, emotional and mental health needs (SEMH). However, a significant number of pupils also have additional needs associated with, for instance, their autism, communication and interaction or speech and language needs.
